fields.climate: tropical; hot, rainy season (June to November); cooler, dry season (November to May)
fields.terrain: flood plain of the Gambia River flanked by some low hills
fields.resources: fish, clay, silica sand, titanium (rutile and ilmenite), tin, zircon
fields.farm: rice, groundnuts, milk, millet, oil palm fruit, maize, vegetables, cassava, fruits, sorghum
fields.exports: packaged medicine, cars, harvesting machinery, refined petroleum, trailers
fields.industries: peanuts, fish, hides, tourism, beverages, agricultural machinery assembly, woodworking, metalworking, clothing
fields.languages: English (official), Mandinka, Wolof, Fula, other indigenous vernaculars
fields.religions: Muslim 96.4%, Christian 3.5%, other or none 0.1% (2019-20 est.)
fields.legal: mixed system of English common law, Islamic law, and customary law
fields.military: 18-28 years of age for men and women depending on enlisted, officer, or specialized positions
